title: CUSTOM: Player request timeouts after cache-path change
events: Sidecar proxy configuration rolled out; no immediate error-rate change.
Cache TTL adjusted; refresh activity expected to rise.
Proxy policy updated for media-cache traffic.
Chatline 429 rate briefly crossed its warning threshold; relay queue remains stable.
Origin fetch volume is elevated; vela-origin responses remain within timeout.
Listener request failures increased; player-core is the most frequent slow dependency.

logs.player-core: WARN media request incomplete: peer=media-cache attempt=2 elapsed_ms=1200 outcome=deadline_exceeded
logs.media-cache: WARN refresh queue lag_ms=4860 origin=vela-origin result=200 pending=37
logs.session-api: ERROR required dependency failed: dependency=player-core elapsed_ms=1500 request_id=7f31
logs.notify-relay: WARN upstream response: provider=Chatline status=429 retry_after_ms=100

truth: The player-core sidecar change adds enough latency on each media-cache attempt that retries consume player-core's 1200 ms budget and cause session-api requests to fail. The simultaneous TTL change increases background refresh traffic and adds pressure, but the Chatline 429 warning is unrelated. Roll back player-core-config and media-cache-config; the config faults are not cleared by restarting services.
